notes:
- Projects: define project types and projects (campaigns, construction, events…), link accruals and income to a project, and follow each project's profit / loss, collection performance and targets under Reports › Projects, with a year-by-year view per project type
- Project codes are suggested from the project type (General → GEN-26; a second one in the same year → GEN-26-02); unused projects and types can be deleted, and used ones show how many records they have
- Financial statements in the standard format: balance sheet with assets and liabilities side by side, income statement with sections and subtotals, journal and general ledger grouped by main account, all on screen and in print
- New account summary: month by month opening, movement and balance of an account
- Chart of accounts: filter by account class, and the row actions (edit, deactivate) are visible buttons
- Negative amounts are always red in financial reports; sub-accounts are no longer indented
- Account reports and dashboards open in your local currency; "Currency" shows the per-currency breakdown
- Lists show amounts in local currency with a single "Currency" column; correcting a record keeps its document number
- A cancelled record can be restored
- Transaction detail: all actions are buttons at the top, with a collection ring and an installment timeline
- Filters are in the page header, and each page's description opens from the (i) next to its title
- The DEMO notice is a yellow DEMO button next to the notifications bell
- Daily cash book shows totals of cash in and cash out; account list opens as a table and remembers your choice
- This update is for Windows; the macOS and Linux versions stay on their current version
